physical_navigation.scope: 20cm new-circuit and SPACE05 courtyard sampling with 48cm body width and 2m height; 60cm grid of all newly authorized walkable areas plus four radius rays. Runtime height defines body base. Old decorative paving joints retain existing .17m support tolerance; new road/ramp tolerance .015m.

limitations: Uses the real navigation and mesh-derived building/ground metadata; independent Blender rays still verify physical geometry.
Quarter-metre connectivity sampling demonstrates access paths, not a continuous mathematical proof. Interior rooms and planted garden parcels remain closed.

old_522_routes.scope: Sampled centerline floor support and 0.48m-wide body-ray checks only, not a navmesh, full-area collision certification or a playable controller.
old_522_routes.known_existing_paving_gaps: Original stone joints can be about 0.12m lower than stone tops; a future walking controller needs step tolerance or a separate collision proxy.

water.scope: Sampled finite background water surface only; no navigation or hydrodynamic claim.

limitations: Read-only scene audit; sampled physical paths are not a proof of every continuous trajectory.
Runtime tree/plot/shader ownership and actual multi-view visual quality are checked separately.
All old source data is preserved behind explicitly hidden replacements; no source blend is saved.
